item.name: Cart
item.description: Run from top to bottom. The first three requests pick two variants that are in stock. The guest requests need no sign in. 'Register a shopper for the bag' signs in as a new customer (10 registers per hour per IP), and the rest uses that session.

item.name: Setup: pick two products in stock

request.description: Saves the slugs of the first two products that are not sold out in `cartSlugA` and `cartSlugB`.

item.name: Setup: a variant of the first product

request.description: Saves the id of the first variant in stock in `cartVariantA`.

item.name: Setup: a variant of the second product

exec: pm.test("two lines, both ok, with the quantities we sent", () => { pm.expect(cart.lines).to.have.lengthOf(2); pm.expect(line(a).quantity).to.eql(2); pm.expect(line(b).quantity).to.eql(1); cart.lines.forEach((l) => pm.expect(l.status).to.eql("ok")); });
pm.test("each line total is price x quantity", () => cart.lines.forEach((l) => pm.expect(l.lineTotalCents).to.eql(l.unitPriceCents * l.quantity)));
const subtotal = cart.lines.reduce((sum, l) => sum + l.lineTotalCents, 0);

pm.test("subtotal, shipping and total add up", () => { pm.expect(cart.subtotalCents).to.eql(subtotal); pm.expect(cart.shippingCents).to.eql(subtotal >= 9700 ? 0 : 695); pm.expect(cart.totalCents).to.eql(subtotal + cart.shippingCents); });
pm.test("no stock number in the response", () => pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.match(/stock/i));

request.description: Prices a guest cart: 2 of the first variant and 1 of the second. No sign in needed. The server works out every price and total; shipping is $6.95 below $97.00.

item.name: Admin
item.description: Run from top to bottom. A new customer buys two orders. The admin ships and delivers one, cancels the other (the stock comes back), deletes a spam review of the delivered one, then creates, edits and hides a product. It needs adminEmail and adminPassword (the seeded admin). It registers one customer per run (10 per hour per IP) and leaves one hidden `postman-...` product and two orders behind in your dev database. It ends signed out.
